records.plant_name: Digital Realty Franklin Park Data Center power station
records.question: Should the Digital Realty and Microsoft Franklin Park plants stay separate, without the uninstalled Digital Realty sets?
records.finding: Digital Realty's campus permit at 9333 Grand Avenue includes building 9401, where Microsoft runs its CHI22 data center with its own twenty-two generators under a separate Microsoft permit. Digital Realty's 2024 emissions report says the twenty-one sets it holds for building 9401, and two at building 9377, are permitted but not installed.
records.recommendation: Keep the two records separate, because the installed generators are counted only once: thirty-nine under Digital Realty and twenty-two under Microsoft. Do not add the uninstalled Digital Realty sets until a source shows work on them.
records.researcher_notes: Digital Realty owns the land and building at 9401 W Grand Avenue, and listing sites call it Digital Realty ORD15. Microsoft owns the generators there and files its own emissions reports, which say they began running in April 2024. The uninstalled Digital Realty sets are two of 2,500 kW at building 9377, and twenty of 3,000 kW and one of 1,500 kW at building 9401, 66.5 MW in all. They have been in the permit since at least November 2020 with no sign of work. Generator EG27 in the permit does not exist, according to the same report.

verifications.note: The Illinois EPA federally enforceable state operating permit for Digital Grand Avenue, LLC (ORD12-13-14) at 9333 Grand Avenue, Franklin Park, Cook County, application 16110009, issued November 19, 2020, expires July 14, 2027, site number 031096AOH. It covers one 500 kW, one 1,000 kW, one 1,250 kW and one 1,500 kW diesel emergency generator set, twenty-six of 2,000 kW, thirteen of 2,500 kW and twenty of 3,000 kW, spread over buildings 9333, 9355, 9377 and 9401. The permit pages are scans and the figures were read from the OCR text.

Digital Grand Avenue's annual emissions report to the Illinois EPA for 2024, site number 031096AOH. The verifier confirmed the file opens and names Digital Grand Avenue. The notes under the generator table, on scanned page 138, say generator EG27 does not exist, and that EG39 and EG40 at building 9377 and EG43 to EG63 at building 9401 are permitted for future expansion but not yet installed. The table total is 146,750 kW. That page is past the 25 pages the automatic check reads, so it was read by eye from the page image.

Microsoft's annual emissions report to the Illinois EPA for 2024, filed April 30, 2025, for the Franklin Park (CHI22) data center. It lists 22 emergency generator sets, EG-01 to EG-022, of 3,266 kW each, and says they began operation in April 2024.

records.plant_name: CyrusOne Aurora Bilter Road Data Center power station
records.question: Should the second phase of generators at CyrusOne Bilter Road be pre-construction or construction?
records.finding: CyrusOne broke ground on the two-building campus in October 2024, and the first phase started up in April 2026. No source reports work on the second building, and CyrusOne has no web page for CHI10.
records.recommendation: Enter the second phase as pre-construction with the December 2024 permit as its milestone, and change it to construction when a source reports work on the second building.
records.researcher_notes: The campus groundbreaking could be read as the start of both buildings, which would make the second phase construction from October 2024. The permit covers both buildings, but CyrusOne's start-up notice of May 2026 names only the first twenty-three generators. The 2025 emissions report says the site did not run in 2025.

verifications.note: Illinois EPA construction permit 24080019 for the CyrusOne CHI9 and CHI10 buildings at 2725 Bilter Road, Aurora, issued December 4, 2024, site number 043407AEH. It covers twenty-three 2,250 kW sets, GEN01 to GEN21 and HOUSE01 and HOUSE02, thirty-three 2,250 kW sets, GEN22 to GEN54, and one 1,250 kW set, HOUSE03.

CyrusOne's notice of initial start-up to the Illinois EPA, dated May 7, 2026 and received June 18, 2026. It says CyrusOne finished commissioning the first phase on April 29, 2026, with the twenty-three generators GEN01 to GEN21 and HOUSE-01 and HOUSE-02.
